I checked both **ORD → Atlanta (ATL)** bookings and applied your **Gold loyalty status**.

| Baggage rule | BK-EP04A — Basic Economy, June 20 | BK-EP04B — Economy, June 28 |
|---|---|---|
| Carry-on allowance | 1 | 1 |
| Checked bags included with fare | 0 | 1 |
| Gold bonus checked bags | 2 | 2 |
| **Total free checked bags** | **2** | **3** |
| Each checked bag beyond the free allowance | $50 | $35 |
| Oversized bag fee | $100 | $100 |

**The key difference:** Your Gold benefits apply to both fares—even Basic Economy. Regular Economy gives you **one more free checked bag** and a lower fee for additional bags.

For example, bringing **3 standard-size checked bags** would cost **$50 on BK-EP04A** but **$0 on BK-EP04B**.

Neither booking currently has paid extra checked bags added. I haven’t changed either reservation.
